text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- UNITA deputies who won seats in the National Assembly in U.N.-sponsored elections in 1992 have finally taken up their seats.

- Angolan President Jose Eduarado de Santos reappointed the country's Prime Minister Fernando Franca Van Dunem after he dismissed the government in a procedural move ahead of the establishment of a unity government. Van Dunem will be head of the unity government.
- Portugese President Jorge Sampiao has arrived in Luanda to attend the inauguration of the unity government.
- Popular Angolan singer "Bonga" has also returned home for the ceremony. Bonga, considered a UNITA sympathizer, has not been in the country for five years.
